browser.noHost: No Deskmony desktop app is open — the browser tools need the desktop app's side panel. Open the desktop app and try again.
browser.hostDisconnected: The Deskmony desktop app disconnected while the browser command was running. Make sure it is still open, then try again.
browser.timeout: The browser did not respond within {{timeoutMs}} ms ({{op}}). The page may be stuck; try again later.
browser.hostNotAllowed: The browser tools can only open localhost or sites listed in policy.allowedHosts; "{{host}}" is not one of them. To allow it, add "{{host}}" to policy.allowedHosts in ~/.deskmony/config.json and restart Deskmony.
browser.unsupportedScheme: The browser tools can only open http:// or https:// addresses, not "{{scheme}}:".
browser.registerNotAllowed: Only the local, non-scoped connection from the Deskmony desktop app can register as the browser host.
browser.resultTooLarge: The browser returned a screenshot that is too large ({{bytes}} bytes, limit {{maxBytes}}).
browser.invalidResult: The browser returned a malformed result ({{op}}): {{detail}}
browser.staleRef: That element reference has expired because the page navigated. Run browser_read_page (interactive) again to get fresh refs.
browser.staleScreenshot: The page's window size changed since the last screenshot, so the coordinates are no longer accurate. Take a new screenshot first.
browser.noScreenshot: Take a screenshot first — the x/y coordinates of browser_click refer to the latest screenshot.
browser.elementNotFound: The element no longer exists or has nothing to click.
